fnol_text: My name is Felix Laurent and I live at 500 Hawthorn Drive, Dover, DE 19984. You can reach me on (555) 645-1734 or felix.laurent@example.com. During the storm on 16 August 2024 high winds ripped tiles off the roof and rain came into the loft and the back bedroom. Policy HH-2024-00156. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Laurent on (555) 645-1734 to acknowledge the claim. Felix confirmed the loss date as 16 August 2024.
Site visit to 500 Hawthorn Drive. Neighbour Zara Ballard was present and confirmed the timeline.
